note: BBVA México's summary for its Tarjeta Azul (issued 4 August 2026): the holder's card administration fee is 748 pesos before VAT, charged on taking the card and at each yearly renewal; the rate is variable, the TIIE de fondeo plus 52 points on purchases, and the bank's stated balance-weighted average rate, 59.52% a year (calculated 13 July 2026), is written, the summary not giving the reference rate's value. VAT isn't added, its rate not being stated.

sources.said: Fecha de emisión: 04/08/2026 ... El crédito es de tasa variable. ... TIIEF + 52 puntos porcentuales para compras. ... Tasa de interés promedio ponderada por saldo en términos anuales 59.52%. ... Fecha de cálculo: 13 de julio de 2026. ... Administración de tarjeta del titular $748 ... anual automática
